rtlDecisions.question: In a calendar grid in RTL, does ArrowLeft move to the previous or the next day?
rtlDecisions.apg: No calendar pattern page; the date picker dialog example binds Left Arrow to the previous day and is silent on RTL.

libraries.behaviour: ArrowLeft focuses the next day and ArrowRight the previous day when direction is rtl.
ArrowLeft adds one day and ArrowRight subtracts one when isRtl.
No arrow-key day navigation found in the panel of @rc-component/picker 1.17.0; only the masked input handles arrows.

rtlDecisions.reason: The week row runs from inline-start, so the first weekday is the right-most column in RTL and time flows leftward; ArrowLeft must go forward one day. Both libraries that implement the grid agree.

data.notes: RTL: the week row starts on the right, so ArrowLeft goes to the next day and ArrowRight to the previous; ArrowUp/ArrowDown, PageUp/PageDown, Home and End are unchanged (Home is still the first weekday, now the right-most column). React Aria and MUI X both swap. The previous-month button sits at inline-start and its chevron mirrors. Home/End differ between sources: APG example = week, React Aria = month; we follow APG. Arabic-first requirements that are data, not keys: the first weekday comes from the region (Saturday in much of the Gulf, Sunday or Monday elsewhere), the calendar system may be Hijri (Umm al-Qura), and day numbers use the locale's numbering system; "same day number" must be computed in the displayed calendar, where months have 29 or 30 days.
